vitrine.onboarding.title: Welcome to Vitrine
vitrine.onboarding.intro: Three things worth knowing before you browse the store:
vitrine.onboarding.section.class_a.title: Class A: textures, themes, HUD, sounds, languages
vitrine.onboarding.section.class_a.body: Applied right away, no restart needed. These packages never run their own program code.
vitrine.onboarding.section.class_b.title: Class B: Java mods (.jar files)
vitrine.onboarding.section.class_b.body: Need a restart and stay hidden by default. Turn on "Show Java mods" in Settings if you want to see them.
A package only gets access to what it declares and you approve — every time, before it installs.
